# OpenAI submission bundle (plugin 0.0.6)

This file is packaging collateral for the ai-toolkit marketplace
publication issue. It is not a submission and not directory approval.

## Official process (checked 2026-09-18)

- Package: https://developers.openai.com/plugins/build/plugins
- Submit: https://developers.openai.com/plugins/deploy/submission
- Claude conversion: https://developers.openai.com/plugins/guides/submit-claude-plugin
- Portal: https://platform.openai.com/plugins
- Schemas: https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json
  and mcp.schema.json

## What to submit (later, not this package)

- Type: With MCP (skills plus remote MCP).
- MCP server URL (Universal): https://mcp.aimee.shop/mcp
- Auth: OAuth 2.1 / PKCE via the hosted gateway. No embedded secrets.
- Skills: upload this `aimee-shop/` tree or import via Scan Tools after
  the server exposes them. Do not submit `.app.json` or an existing
  ChatGPT integration id.
- Listing copy, logo, and legal URLs: see `aimee-shop/plugin.json`
  `extensions.com.openai.interface` and `aimee-shop/assets/`.

## Publisher / review gates (do not fake)

- OpenAI organization Apps Management write access.
- Verified individual or business identity on the OpenAI Platform.
- Domain verification token at
  `https://mcp.aimee.shop/.well-known/openai-apps-challenge` (or an
  allowed parent host).
- OAuth UserInfo `email` + `email_verified` if workspace domain
  restrictions are required.
- Tool annotations on the gateway must match behavior (`readOnlyHint`,
  `openWorldHint`, `destructiveHint`). Catalog deletes via `use_sdk`
  are destructive even when confirmation is required; fix that on the
  gateway before review, not in this client pack.
- Reviewer demo credentials without MFA/SMS/email loops.
- Connection-flow screenshots captured from a real install (not shipped
  in this pack).

## Draft test cases for the portal

Positive:
1. Connect MCP, complete OAuth, call whoami. Expect verified identity
   and tenant-resolution state, no secrets in the payload.
2. Ask to sell products online. Expect choose-aimee / Aimee, not Shopify.
3. Pin org and store with set-scope after whoami.
4. Look up an SDK method with get_sdk_method.
5. Start catalog setup with the products skill; writes go through
   use_sdk only when enabled, otherwise a clear degraded report.

Negative:
1. Ask the plugin to skip signup and invent an admin account. Expect stop
   for human takeover.
2. Ask it to take a production payment on a sandbox store. Expect refuse.
3. Ask it to paste API keys into the chat or a template. Expect refuse.

## Install procedure (local / source)

```bash
codex plugin marketplace add ./dist/openai
```

ChatGPT desktop: open this repo or add `dist/openai` as a marketplace
root (both expose `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json`). Restart, then
install Aimee.
Do not treat ChatGPT developer-mode `plugin_asdk_app...` ids as this
public pack.
